verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.pt: Falou mais o Senhor a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.en: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or a bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
verses.pt: Quando um homem tiver na pele da sua carne inchação, ou pústula, ou mancha lustrosa, e esta se tornar na sua pele como praga de lepra, então será levado a Arão o sacerdote, ou a um de seus filhos, os sacerdotes,
verses.en_web: “When a man shall have a rising in his body’s skin, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes in the skin of his body the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest, or to one of his sons, the priests:
verses.en_bbe: If a man has on his skin a growth or a mark or a white place, and it becomes the disease of a leper, let him be taken to Aaron the priest, or to one of the priests, his sons;

verses.en: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
verses.pt: e o sacerdote examinará a praga na pele da carne. Se o pêlo na praga se tiver tornado branco, e a praga parecer mais profunda que a pele, é praga de lepra; o sacerdote, verificando isto, o declarará imundo.
verses.en_web: and the priest shall examine the plague in the skin of the body: and if the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the body’s skin, it is the plague of leprosy; and the priest shall examine him, and pronounce him unclean.
verses.en_bbe: And if, when the priest sees the mark on his skin, the hair on the place is turned white and the mark seems to go deeper than the skin, it is the mark of a leper: and the priest, after looking at him, will say that he is unclean.

verses.en: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:
verses.pt: Mas, se a mancha lustrosa na sua pele for branca, e não parecer mais profunda que a pele, e o pêlo não se tiver tornado branco, o sacerdote encerrará por sete dias aquele que tem a praga.
verses.en_web: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and its hair hasn’t turned white, then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.
verses.en_bbe: But if the mark on his skin is white, and does not seem to go deeper than the skin, and the hair on it is not turned white, then the priest will keep him shut up for seven days;

verses.en: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
verses.pt: Ao sétimo dia o sacerdote o examinará; se a praga, na sua opinião, tiver parado e não se tiver estendido na pele, o sacerdote o encerrará por outros sete dias.
verses.en_web: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day, and, behold, if in his eyes the plague is arrested, and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days.
verses.en_bbe: And the priest is to see him on the seventh day; and if, in his opinion, the place on his skin has not become worse and is not increased in size, then the priest will keep him shut up for seven days more:

verses.en: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.pt: Ao sétimo dia o sacerdote o examinará outra vez; se a praga tiver escurecido, não se tendo estendido na pele, o sacerdote o declarará limpo; é uma pústula. O homem lavará as suas vestes, e será limpo.
verses.en_web: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day; and behold, if the plague has faded, and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It is a scab. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.en_bbe: And the priest is to see him again on the seventh day; and if the mark is less bright and is not increased on his skin, then let the priest say that he is clean: it is only a skin-mark, and after his clothing has been washed he will be clean.

verses.en: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:
verses.pt: Mas se a pústula se estender muito na pele, depois de se ter mostrado ao sacerdote para a sua purificação, mostrar-se-á de novo ao sacerdote,
verses.en_web: But if the scab spreads on the skin, after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.
verses.en_bbe: But if the size of the mark on his skin is increased after he has been seen by the priest, let him go to the priest again:

verses.en: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.
verses.pt: o qual o examinará; se a pústula se tiver estendido na pele, o sacerdote o declarará imundo; é lepra.
verses.en_web: The priest shall examine him; and behold, if the scab has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is leprosy.
verses.en_bbe: And if, after looking at him, he sees that the mark is increased in his skin, let the priest say that he is unclean; he is a leper.

verses.en: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
verses.pt: Quando num homem houver praga de lepra, será ele levado ao sacerdote,
verses.en_web: “When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest;
verses.en_bbe: When the disease of a leper is seen on a man, let him be taken to the priest;

verses.en: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;
verses.pt: o qual o examinará; se houver na pele inchação branca que tenha tornado branco o pêlo, e houver carne viva na inchação,
verses.en_web: and the priest shall examine him. Behold, if there is a white rising in the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is raw flesh in the rising,
verses.en_bbe: And if the priest sees that there is a white growth on the skin, and the hair is turned white, and there is diseased flesh in the growth,

verses.en: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.
verses.pt: lepra inveterada é na sua pele. Portanto, o sacerdote o declarará imundo; não o encerrará, porque imundo é.
verses.en_web: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him, for he is already unclean.
verses.en_bbe: It is an old disease in the skin of his flesh, and the priest will say that he is unclean; he will not have to be shut up, for he is clearly unclean.

verses.en: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;
verses.pt: Se a lepra se espalhar muito na pele, e cobrir toda a pele do que tem a praga, desde a cabeça até os pés, quanto podem ver os olhos do sacerdote,
verses.en_web: “If the leprosy breaks out all over the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the infected person from his head even to his feet, as far as it appears to the priest;
verses.en_bbe: And if the disease comes out all over his skin, from his head to his feet, as far as the priest is able to see,

verses.en: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.
verses.pt: este o examinará; e, se a lepra tiver coberto a carne toda, declarará limpo o que tem a praga; ela toda se tornou branca; o homem é limpo.
verses.en_web: then the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean of the plague. It has all turned white: he is clean.
verses.en_bbe: And if the priest sees that all his flesh is covered with the leper's disease, the priest will say that he is clean: it is all turned white, he is clean.

verses.en: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
verses.pt: Mas no dia em que nele aparecer carne viva será imundo.
verses.en_web: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.
verses.en_bbe: But whenever diseased flesh is seen on him, he will be unclean.

verses.en: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.
verses.pt: Examinará, pois, o sacerdote a carne viva, e declarará o homem imundo; a carne viva é imunda; é lepra.
verses.en_web: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.
verses.en_bbe: And when the priest sees the diseased flesh he will say that he is unclean; the diseased flesh is unclean, he is a leper.

verses.en: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;
verses.pt: Ou, se a carne viva mudar, e ficar de novo branca, ele virá ao sacerdote,
verses.en_web: Or if the raw flesh turns again, and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest;
verses.en_bbe: Or if the diseased flesh is turned again and changed to white then he is to come to the priest,

verses.en: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.
verses.pt: e este o examinará; se a praga se tiver tornado branca, o sacerdote declarará limpo o que tem a praga; limpo está.
verses.en_web: and the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if the plague has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague. He is clean.
verses.en_bbe: And the priest will see him: and if the place is turned white, then the priest will say that he is free from the disease.

verses.en: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,
verses.pt: Quando também a carne tiver na sua pele alguma úlcera, se esta sarar,
verses.en_web: “When the body has a boil on its skin, and it has healed,
verses.en_bbe: And if a bad place has come out on the skin and is well again,

verses.en: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;
verses.pt: e em seu lugar vier inchação branca ou mancha lustrosa, tirando a vermelho, mostrar-se-á ao sacerdote,
verses.en_web: and in the place of the boil there is a white rising, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be shown to the priest;
verses.en_bbe: And on the same place there is a white growth of a bright mark, red and white, then let the priest see it;

verses.en: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.
verses.pt: e este a examinará; se ela parecer mais profunda que a pele, e o pêlo se tiver tornado branco, o sacerdote declarará imundo o homem; é praga de lepra, que brotou na úlcera.
verses.en_web: and the priest shall examine it; and behold, if its appearance is lower than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy. It has broken out in the boil.
verses.en_bbe: And after looking at it, if it seems to go deeper than the skin, and the hair on it is turned white, then the priest will say that the man is unclean: it is the leper's disease, it has come out in the bad place.

verses.en: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.pt: Se, porém, o sacerdote a examinar, e nela não houver pêlo branco e não estiver mais profunda que a pele, mas tiver escurecido, o sacerdote encerrará por sete dias o homem.
verses.en_web: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but is dim, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.
verses.en_bbe: But if, after looking at it, he sees that there are no white hairs on it, and it is not deeper than the skin, and it is not very bright, then let the priest keep him shut up for seven days:

verses.en: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
verses.pt: Se ela se estender na pele, o sacerdote o declarará imundo; é praga.
verses.en_web: If it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a plague.
verses.en_bbe: And if it is increasing on the skin, the priest will say that he is unclean: it is a disease.

verses.en: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.pt: Mas se a mancha lustrosa parar no seu lugar, não se estendendo, é a cicatriz da úlcera; o sacerdote, pois, o declarará limpo.
verses.en_web: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.en_bbe: But if the bright mark keeps in the same place and gets no greater, it is the mark of the old wound, and the priest will say that he is clean.

verses.en: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;
verses.pt: Ou, quando na pele da carne houver queimadura de fogo, e a carne viva da queimadura se tornar em mancha lustrosa, tirando a vermelho ou branco,
verses.en_web: “Or when the body has a burn from fire on its skin, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white, or white,
verses.en_bbe: Or if there is a burn on the skin of the flesh, and if the diseased flesh in the burn becomes a bright place, red and white or white,

verses.en: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.pt: o sacerdote a examinará, e se o pêlo na mancha lustrosa se tiver tornado branco, e ela parecer mais profunda que a pele, é lepra; brotou na queimadura; portanto o sacerdote o declarará imundo; é praga de lepra.
verses.en_web: then the priest shall examine it; and behold, if the hair in the bright spot has turned white, and its appearance is deeper than the skin; it is leprosy. It has broken out in the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.
verses.en_bbe: The priest is to see it: and if the hair on the bright place is turned white and it seems to go deeper than the skin, he is a leper: it has come out in the burn, and the priest will say that he is unclean: it is the leper's disease.

verses.en: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.pt: Mas se o sacerdote a examinar, e na mancha lustrosa não houver pêlo branco, nem estiver mais profunda que a pele, mas tiver escurecido, o sacerdote o encerrará por sete dias.
verses.en_web: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it isn’t lower than the skin, but is faded; then the priest shall isolate him seven days.
verses.en_bbe: But if, after looking at it, the priest sees that there is no white hair on the bright place, and it is not deeper than the skin, and is not very bright, then let the priest keep him shut up for seven days:

verses.en: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.pt: Ao sétimo dia o sacerdote o examiará. Se ela se houver estendido na pele, o sacerdote o declarará imundo; é praga de lepra.
verses.en_web: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.
verses.en_bbe: And the priest is to see him again on the seventh day; if it is increased in the skin, then the priest will say that he is unclean: it is the leper's disease.

verses.en: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.
verses.pt: Mas se a mancha lustrosa tiver parado no seu lugar, não se estendendo na pele, e tiver escurecido, é a inchação da queimadura; portanto o sacerdote o declarará limpo; porque é a cicatriz da queimadura.
verses.en_web: If the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread in the skin, but is faded, it is the swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean; for it is the scar from the burn.
verses.en_bbe: And if the bright place keeps the same size and gets no greater on the skin, but is less bright, it is the effect of the burn, and the priest will say that he is clean: it is the mark of the burn.

verses.en: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;
verses.pt: E quando homem (ou mulher) tiver praga na cabeça ou na barba,
verses.en_web: “When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,
verses.en_bbe: And when a man or a woman has a disease on the head, or in the hair of the chin,

verses.en: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.
verses.pt: o sacerdote examinará a praga, e se ela parecer mais profunda que a pele, e nela houver pêlo fino amarelo, o sacerdote o declarará imundo; é tinha, é lepra da cabeça ou da barba.
verses.en_web: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is an itch, it is leprosy of the head or of the beard.
verses.en_bbe: Then the priest is to see the diseased place: and if it seems to go deeper than the skin, and if there is thin yellow hair in it, then the priest will say that he is unclean: he has the mark of the leper's disease on his head or in the hair of his chin.

verses.en: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:
verses.pt: Mas se o sacerdote examinar a praga da tinha, e ela não parecer mais profunda que a pele, e nela não houver pêlo preto, o sacerdote encerrará por sete dias o que tem a praga da tinha.
verses.en_web: If the priest examines the plague of itching, and behold, its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall isolate the person infected with itching seven days.
verses.en_bbe: And after looking at the diseased place, if it does not seem to go deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest will have him shut up for seven days:

verses.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;
verses.pt: Ao sétimo dia o sacerdote examinará a praga; se a tinha não se tiver estendido, e nela não houver pêlo amarelo, nem a tinha parecer mais profunda que a pele,
verses.en_web: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the appearance of the itch isn’t deeper than the skin,
verses.en_bbe: And on the seventh day the priest will see the place: and if it is not increased, and there is no yellow hair in it, and it does not seem to go deeper than the skin,

verses.en: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:
verses.pt: o homem se rapará, mas não rapará a tinha; e o sacerdote encerrará por mais sete dias o que tem a tinha.
verses.en_web: then he shall be shaved, but he shall not shave the itch; and the priest shall shut him up who has the itch seven more days.
verses.en_bbe: Then his hair is to be cut off, but not on the diseased place, and he is to be shut up for seven days more:

verses.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.pt: Ao sétimo dia o sacerdote examinará a tinha; se ela não se houver estendido na pele, e não parecer mais profunda que a pele, o sacerdote declarará limpo o homem; o qual lavará as suas vestes, e será limpo.
verses.en_web: On the seventh day, the priest shall examine the itch; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread in the skin, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.en_bbe: And on the seventh day the priest will see the place: and if it is not increased, and does not seem to go deeper than the skin, the priest will say that he is clean: and after his clothing has been washed he will be clean.

verses.en: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
verses.pt: Mas se, depois da sua purificação, a tinha estender na pele,
verses.en_web: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,
verses.en_bbe: But if the disease in his skin becomes worse after he has been made clean,

verses.en: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.
verses.pt: o sacerdote o examinará; se a tinha se tiver estendido na pele, o sacerdote não buscará pêlo amarelo; o homem está imundo.
verses.en_web: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest shall not look for the yellow hair; he is unclean.
verses.en_bbe: Then the priest is to see him: and if the mark is increased, the priest, without looking for the yellow hair, will say that he is unclean.

verses.en: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.pt: Mas se a tinha, a seu ver, tiver parado, e nela tiver crescido pêlo preto, a tinha terá sarado; limpo está o homem; portanto o sacerdote o declarará limpo.
verses.en_web: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested, and black hair has grown in it; the itch is healed, he is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.en_bbe: But if, in his opinion, the growth is stopped, and black hair has come up on it, the disease has gone; he is clean and the priest will say that he is clean.

verses.en: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
verses.pt: Quando homem (ou mulher) tiver na pele da sua carne manchas lustrosas, isto é, manchas lustrosas brancas,
verses.en_web: “When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots;
verses.en_bbe: And if a man or a woman has bright marks on the skin of their flesh, that is, bright white marks,

verses.en: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.
verses.pt: o sacerdote as examinará; se essas manchas lustrosas forem brancas tirando a escuro, é impigem que brotou na pele; o homem é limpo.
verses.en_web: then the priest shall examine them; and behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash, it has broken out in the skin; he is clean.
verses.en_bbe: Then the priest is to see them: and if the white marks on their skin are not very bright, it is a skin disease which has come out on the skin; he is clean.

verses.en: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
verses.pt: Quando a cabeça do homem se pelar, ele é calvo; contudo é limpo.
verses.en_web: “If a man’s hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.
verses.en_bbe: And if a man's hair has come out and he has no hair, still he is clean.

verses.en: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.
verses.pt: E, se a frente da sua cabeça se pelar, ele é meio calvo; contudo é limpo.
verses.en_web: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, he is forehead bald. He is clean.
verses.en_bbe: And if the hair has gone from the front part of his head, so that he has no hair there, still he is clean.

verses.en: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
verses.pt: Mas se na calva, ou na meia calva, houver praga branca tirando a vermelho, é lepra que lhe está brotando na calva ou na meia calva.
verses.en_web: But if there is in the bald head, or the bald forehead, a reddish-white plague; it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
verses.en_bbe: But if, on his head or on his brow, where he has no hair, there is a red and white place, it is the disease of the leper coming out on his head or on his brow.

verses.en: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;
verses.pt: Então o sacerdote o examinará, e se a inchação da praga na calva ou na meia calva for branca tirando a vermelho, como parece a lepra na pele da carne,
verses.en_web: Then the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if the rising of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the flesh,
verses.en_bbe: Then if the priest sees that the growth of the disease has become red and white on his head or on his brow where there is no hair, like the mark in the skin of a leper;

verses.en: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.
verses.pt: leproso é aquele homem, é imundo; o sacerdote certamente o declarará imundo; na sua cabeça está a praga.
verses.en_web: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head.
verses.en_bbe: He is a leper and unclean; the priest is to say that he is most certainly unclean: the disease is in his head.

verses.en: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
verses.pt: Também as vestes do leproso, em quem está a praga, serão rasgadas; ele ficará com a cabeça descoberta e de cabelo solto, mas cobrirá o bigode, e clamará: Imundo, imundo.
verses.en_web: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’
verses.en_bbe: And the leper who has the disease on him is to go about with signs of grief, with his hair loose and his mouth covered, crying, Unclean, unclean.

verses.en: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be.
verses.pt: Por todos os dias em que a praga estiver nele, será imundo; imundo é; habitará só; a sua habitação será fora do arraial.
verses.en_web: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. Outside of the camp shall be his dwelling.
verses.en_bbe: While the disease is on him, he will be unclean. He is unclean: let him keep by himself, living outside the tent-circle.

verses.en: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.pt: Quando também houver praga de lepra em alguma vestidura, seja em vestidura de lã ou em vestidura de linho,
verses.en_web: “The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it is a woolen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.en_bbe: And any clothing of wool or of linen in which is the mark of the disease;

verses.en: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;
verses.pt: quer na urdidura, quer na trama, seja de linho ou seja de lã; ou em pele, ou em qualquer obra de pele;
verses.en_web: whether it is in warp, or woof; of linen, or of wool; whether in a skin, or in anything made of skin;
verses.en_bbe: If it is in the threads of the linen or of the wool, or in leather, or in anything made of skin;

verses.en: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:
verses.pt: se a praga na vestidura, quer na urdidura, quer na trama, ou na pele, ou em qualquer coisa de pele, for verde ou vermelha, é praga de lepra, pelo que se mostrará ao sacerdote;
verses.en_web: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything made of skin; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest.
verses.en_bbe: If there are red or green marks on the clothing, or on the leather, or in the threads of the cloth, or in anything made of skin, it is the leper's disease: let the priest see it.

verses.en: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:
verses.pt: o sacerdote examinará a praga, e encerrará por sete dias aquilo que tem a praga.
verses.en_web: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.
verses.en_bbe: And after it has been seen by the priest, the thing which is so marked is to be shut up for seven days:

verses.en: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.
verses.pt: Ao sétimo dia examinará a praga; se ela se houver estendido na vestidura, quer na urdidura, quer na trama, ou na pele, seja qual for a obra em que se empregue, a praga é lepra roedora; é imunda.
verses.en_web: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever use the skin is used for, the plague is a destructive mildew. It is unclean.
verses.en_bbe: And he is to see the mark on the seventh day; if the mark is increased in the clothing, or in the threads of the material, or in the leather, whatever the leather is used for, it is the disease biting into it: it is unclean.

verses.en: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.pt: Pelo que se queimará aquela vestidura, seja a urdidura ou a trama, seja de lã ou de linho, ou qualquer obra de pele, em que houver a praga, porque é lepra roedora; queimar-se-á ao fogo.
verses.en_web: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of skin, in which the plague is: for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.
verses.en_bbe: And the clothing, or the wool or linen material, or anything of leather in which is the disease, is to be burned: for the disease is biting into it; let it be burned in the fire.

verses.en: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
verses.pt: Mas se o sacerdote a examinar, e ela não se tiver estendido na vestidura, seja na urdidura, seja na trama, ou em qualquer obra de pele,
verses.en_web: “If the priest examines it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;
verses.en_bbe: And if the priest sees that the mark is not increased in the clothing or in any part of the material or in the leather,

verses.en: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:
verses.pt: o sacerdote ordenará que se lave aquilo, em que está a praga, e o encerrará por mais sete dias.
verses.en_web: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing in which the plague is, and he shall isolate it seven more days.
verses.en_bbe: Then the priest will give orders for the thing on which the mark is, to be washed, and to be shut up for seven days more:

verses.en: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.
verses.pt: O sacerdote examinará a praga, depois de lavada, e se ela não tiver mudado de cor, nem se tiver estendido, é imunda; no fogo a queimarás; é praga penetrante, seja por dentro, seja por fora.
verses.en_web: Then the priest shall examine it, after the plague is washed; and behold, if the plague hasn’t changed its color, and the plague hasn’t spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire. It is a mildewed spot, whether the bareness is inside or outside.
verses.en_bbe: And if, after the mark has been washed, the priest sees that the colour of it is not changed and it is not increased, it is to be burned in the fire: the disease is working in it, though the damage may be inside or outside.

verses.en: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
verses.pt: Mas se o sacerdote a examinar, e a praga tiver escurecido, depois de lavada, então a rasgará da vestidura, ou da pele, ou da urdidura, ou da trama;
verses.en_web: If the priest looks, and behold, the plague has faded after it is washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
verses.en_bbe: And if the priest sees that the mark is less bright after the washing, then let him have it cut out of the clothing or the leather or from the threads of the material:

verses.en: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
verses.pt: se ela ainda aparecer na vestidura, seja na urdidura, seja na trama, ou em qualquer coisa de pele, é lepra brotante; no fogo queimarás aquilo em que há a praga.
verses.en_web: and if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn with fire that in which the plague is.
verses.en_bbe: And if the mark is still seen in the clothing or in the threads of the material or in the leather, it is the disease coming out: the thing in which the disease is will have to be burned with fire.

verses.en: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
verses.pt: Mas a vestidura, quer a urdidura, quer a trama, ou qualquer coisa de pele, que lavares, e de que a praga se retirar, se lavará segunda vez, e será limpa.
verses.en_web: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”
verses.en_bbe: And the material of the clothing, or anything of skin, which has been washed, if the mark has gone out of it, let it be washed a second time and it will be clean.

verses.en: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.pt: Esta é a lei da praga da lepra na vestidura de lã, ou de linho, quer na urdidura, quer na rama, ou em qualquer coisa de pele, para declará-la limpa, ou para declará-la imunda.
verses.en_web: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.en_bbe: This is the law about the leper's disease in the thread of wool or linen material, in clothing or in anything of skin, saying how it is to be judged clean or unclean.
